//: Feature profile for this deployment. One switch per feature: `true` includes its schema fragment (the src/**/schema.sql declaring `-- feature: <id>`) and its code (src/features/<id>/). Run `npm run build` after editing. Turning a feature OFF never drops existing tables — it only stops creating them on fresh installs. WARNING: turning off `plugins` removes the /__cms write-back API that installed plugin Workers call, the plugin admin proxy and the manage screen. Any registered plugin stops working. Dependencies are declared in each feature's feature.ts and validated at startup.
